identityStatus: Named OSM way 899344096 fixes the modern chapel identity, center and street-relative heading. The nomination’s measured outer walls supersede the generalized map width.

notes: National Register field documentation defines the 28-by-48-foot adobe shell, red gable, north entrance and opening layout. Three cleared Qualla originals show the plaster colors and establish the proportions and profile of the bell opening and main north parapet.
